_doc: Who may run a person's /compact. The gateway (scripts/watch_gateway.py _compact_allowed) enforces it; the API (api/src/lib/seatSettings.ts seatCanCompactNow) reports it as compact_now so the slideout offers Compact now only where it works. Both read the two flags here and both run every case, so they cannot drift. needs_headless: the seat is switched on headless and not in Dev (in Dev its TUI runs in the pane, so it reads as not headless). needs_test_seat: its registry row has test exactly true, found by seat id or tmux_session. A reader that cannot read this file refuses. In each case, registry is the seat's registry row (keyed by seat), or null for no row; headless means switched on headless; dev means its Dev marker exists.
